title: Oscillatory blow-up and gradient estimates for semilinear heat equations
summary: For reaction-diffusion with blow-up nonlinearities, we consider the question whether the sup norm of any positive blow-up solution must be eventually monotone nondecreasing in time. While some sufficient conditions are known, especially for radial solutions, this natural and basic question for the blow-up theory does not seem to have been addressed so far in full generality. We construct surprising (nonradial) counter-examples of blow-up solutions with oscillatory $L^\infty$ norm, for any Sobolev supercritical power nonlinearity, which show that this property may fail.
